name: Chase Sapphire Reserve

intro_offer.headline: 60,000 bonus points
intro_offer.spend_requirement: $4,000 in purchases in the first 3 months

rewards.on: hotels and car rentals booked through Chase Travel

regular_apr: 21.99% to 28.99% variable, depending on your credit
rating_reason: The $300 annual travel credit drops the effective cost to $250 a year. At 3x on dining and travel, heavy restaurant and hotel spenders typically clear that hurdle by spring. The Priority Pass lounge access and Global Entry credit add real value if you fly four or more times a year.
best_for: people who spend $500 or more a month on dining and travel combined
frequent flyers who use airport lounges
skip_if: you spend less than $500 a month on dining and travel combined; the math will not work in your favor
